acceptance_item: M2 §7/§19 + M3 §12 + M4 §15 - financial invariants / independent protective exit
invariant: unrealized_return < -0.005 triggers a mandatory protective exit
independence: execution bridge state (active, BLOCKED, or conflicting)
L1 microstructure intelligence (stale, crossed, or absent)

m4_execution_independence_verified.exit_is_broker_compatible_market_order: protective_exit uses MARKET (not a planner limit order)

mechanism: trade.py routes the protective exit path from authoritative native market state directly into the RiskEngine/OrderManager, bypassing elective discovery/intelligence/optimization. Exits are never gated by the exposure authorizer and are never arbitrated.

bridge_independence_verified.inflight_elective_order_does_not_block_m: protective_exit uses a SEPARATE single-pending key (strategy_id 'protective_exit') from the bridge's 'regime_intelligence'; an in-flight elective order on the same symbol never blocks the mandatory close
bridge_independence_verified.never_arbitrated: StrategyArbitrator only resolves elective recommendations; it emits/blocks no exit

optimizer_independence_verified_m3.fires_when_optimizer_or_gpu_fails: the protective-exit path never calls the portfolio optimizer/covariance; a raising portfolio pipeline does not affect it
optimizer_independence_verified_m3.inflight_portfolio_order_does_not_block_: protective_exit vs StrategyName.PORTFOLIO are separate single-pending keys; can_submit('protective_exit', sym) True while can_submit('portfolio', sym) False

status: PRESERVED + independence re-verified against the execution bridge, portfolio optimizer, execution planner, and L1 microstructure
